subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept this grouped set of 14 Action upgrades in credentialed and security-sensitive workflows once the branch is rebased and fresh checks pass?
rationale: The patch changes third-party executable code that handles tokens, registry credentials, API keys, and security scan output, and the protected `security` label requires explicit maintainer handling even though no concrete vulnerability was found.

options.title: Verify and merge together
options.body: Rebase the branch, confirm every immutable SHA against its official release, require fresh affected-workflow checks, and approve the grouped update.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Land low-privilege setup actions separately and review Codex, token, registry, labeling, stale, and CodeQL action upgrades in smaller PRs.

options.title: Pause for Dependabot recovery
options.body: Wait until Dependabot can access and maintain the branch reliably before performing the final stable-head review.

recommendation.title: Verify and merge together
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch, confirm every immutable SHA against its official release, require fresh affected-workflow checks, and approve the grouped update.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available owner for repository-wide CI, release, and security-sensitive workflow acceptance.
